description: Creates a rule that is checked every hour after the data refresh. When any matching deployment crosses the threshold, YieldCave POSTs a JSON payload to your HTTPS webhook (Slack, Discord, Zapier, your own server). Fires at most once per 24 hours per rule. universe "rwa" (tokenized treasuries, default) or "stablecoin" (stablecoin pools with at least $10M TVL; omit symbol for all major stablecoins). Returns the alert id; keep it to delete the alert later.

label.description: Free text shown in the payload

symbol.description: One token, e.g. "USDY". Omit for every tokenized treasury

webhookUrl.description: Where to POST when the alert fires

name: create_alert
title: Create a webhook alert
